def generateSAStoken(account_name, container_name, blob_name):

    # get the adls connection_string
    adls_connectionstring = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecretWithLS(key_vault_linkedservice, kv_secret)

    # retrieve only the account_key value from adls connection_string
    account_key = (account_key.split(";")[2]).removeprefix("AccountKey=")

    # generate sas token with validity
    sas_token = generate_blob_sas(account_name=account_name,
                                    container_name=container_name,
                                    blob_name=blob_name,
                                    account_key=account_key,
                                    permission=BlobSasPermissions(read=True),
                                    expiry=datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(days=120),
                                    resource="b")

    urlDoc = f"https://{account_name}.blob.core.windows.net/{container_name}/{blob_name}?{sas_token}"

    return(urlDoc)
